inv.desc_ca:
Immobiliària a Carabanchel, Marquès de Vadillo Madrid - Tecnocasa Inmogeneral Ricardos 2020 SL.
Tecnocasa ven magnífica Nau-Local, consta de diverses sales àmplies, despatx, dos banys i un vestidor. Molt lluminós ja que envolta un pati de llums, situada en un dels carrers més comercials de Marquès De Vadillo.

Existeix la possibilitat d'aconseguir el 100% de finançament sobre la compra, es realitza estudi financer gratuït pel departament financer Kiron del grup tecnocasa.
NO DUBTI EN FER UNA VISITA.

Per a més informació, no dubtin a posar-se en contacte amb nosaltres a través del telèfon fix per mòbil o WhatsApp: i per correu electrònic.

inv.desc_en:
Real estate in Carabanchel, Marques de Vadillo Madrid - Tecnocasa Inmogeneral Ricardos 2020 SL.
Tecnocasa sells magnificent Nave-Local, it consists of several large rooms, office, two bathrooms and a dressing room. Very bright since it surrounds a patio of lights, located in one of the most commercial streets of Marques De Vadillo.

There is the possibility of obtaining 100% financing on the purchase, a free financial study is carried out by the Kiron financial department of the Tecnocasa group.
DO NOT HESITATE TO MAKE A VISIT.

For more information, do not hesitate to contact us through the landline by mobile or WhatsApp: and by email.

LEGAL NOTICE: We remind our Gentlemen clients that the information provided does not constitute an authentic binding or contractual offer. This advertisement is provisional, and the photographs and data included in it are subject to possible modifications, as a consequence of commercial, legal, technical requirements or by express mandate of the property. The information contained herein seeks to reflect an orientation on the properties as of the date of its publication. All the content that appears has a merely informative and approximate nature, not having, in any way, a contractual nature. Both the data, as well as the images and plans may be subject to changes, so we invite you that, if you need more accurate and detailed information, contact us and we will assist you as soon as possible. The contents are for informational purposes only and under no circumstances should they be used or considered as an offer for sale or financing, a request for an offer to purchase or financing, or a recommendation to carry out any other transaction, unless expressly indicated. The information and documentation to be offered in accordance with the provisions of Royal Decree 515/1989 (of April 21, regarding the protection of consumers in terms of the information to be provided in the sale and lease of homes), will be made available to potential buyers in the respective territorial delegations managing the property.
